provenance.canonicalisation: RFC 8785 JCS via scripts/jcs.py; set hash is SHA-256 over JCS(vectors).
provenance.signatures: Ed25519 over domain || lowercase SHA-256 hex using fixed public test seeds; dependency-free RFC 8032 verifier.
provenance.status: candidate — no Demos runtime guarantee and no second-implementation cross-run yet
provenance.syntheticProofProfile: demos-bft-proof/test-1 fixtures define outputHash as SHA-256(JCS(storageOutput)), SHA-256(JCS(native transfer payload)), or SHA-256(JCS({accepted:true,operationId})); effectsRoot is SHA-256(JCS({pre,post})). These are test-only formulas, not production Demos wire claims.

coverage.note: Across the generated corpus, every applicable rule polarity has a fixture; non-applicable cells require an explicit rationale, and boundaryRuleRefs attribute only the rule edges actually exercised.

vectors.name: awb-completion-receipt-not-final
vectors.reason: Completion receipt alone cannot finalize DACS-5.

vectors.name: awb-work-carried-bundle-profile-deferred
vectors.reason: The conditional Work-carried bundle proof chain is deferred until a later exact Work profile standardizes bundle bytes and authorization.

vectors.name: awb-purchase-evidence-required
vectors.reason: Role anchoring requires independently verified Purchase as well as Completion evidence.

vectors.name: awb-purchase-completion-mismatch
vectors.reason: The unstandardized later-Work bundle path cannot establish this proof chain.

vectors.name: awb-self-consistent-forged-roster
vectors.reason: No v1 Work-carried bundle profile exists, so this synthetic roster is not accepted as a bundle-anchor test.

vectors.name: awb-outer-writer-not-role
vectors.reason: No v1 Work-carried bundle profile exists; native writer never establishes DACS role authority.

vectors.name: awb-bundlebinding-role-mismatch
vectors.reason: The conditional Work-carried BundleBinding path remains unstandardized in v1.

vectors.name: awb-bundlebinding-missing
vectors.reason: Missing role binding evidence is indeterminate rather than inferred.

vectors.name: awb-anchor-content-mismatch
vectors.reason: No v1 Work profile carries the actual receipt-dependent bundle content to test this conditional proof chain.

vectors.name: awb-receipt-dependent-bundle-in-completion
vectors.reason: Receipt-dependent bundle bytes cannot be authored inside Completion Work.

vectors.name: awb-idempotent-nonpaying-audit-tail
vectors.reason: The audit tail establishes final role anchoring by verifying both finalized Works and every dependency proof before publishing without payment.

vectors.name: awb-audit-dependency-proof-missing
vectors.reason: A missing Purchase or Completion operation proof leaves audit finalisation indeterminate.

vectors.name: awb-audit-replay-no-duplicate
vectors.reason: An authenticated exact lifecycle replay produces no duplicate effect.

vectors.name: awb-audit-replay-competing-bytes
vectors.reason: A cryptographically valid competing-byte write cannot overwrite the immutable audit address.

vectors.name: awb-repair-never-replays-purchase
vectors.reason: Repair/finalization never contains payment or slot operations.
